- Comment quality — does the comment explain WHY (best-effort, teardown must run, resume fails loudly later)?
- Test quality: does the regression test actually exercise the finally path, or could it pass trivially? Is the assertion meaningful?
- Dead code / naming / magic values introduced by THIS change only.
Run `make typecheck` to confirm clean. Note: pre-existing lint errors in docs/superpowers/spikes/ are NOT this commit's concern.
